task.title: Reporting a Cybersecurity Incident
task.shortdesc: Report cybersecurity incidents to the NC State Help Desk.

context.p: Anyone in the campus community can report a .

step.cmd: Email or call the NC State Help Desk with the gathered information.

Report criminal activity (such as theft) to the Campus Police Department by calling (919) 515-3000. Contact NC State's Security and Compliance Cybersecurity Operations team for assistance with connecting to external law enforcement agencies (such as the FBI).
